_metadata.description: Soil suitability matrix for major field crops in India

sources.soil_classification: ICAR - National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning (NBSS&LUP), Nagpur
sources.suitability_criteria: ICAR land capability classes and crop-soil suitability ratings

prototype_assumptions: Pegging penalty for Groundnut in heavy shrink-swell Black Soils (0.85)

alluvial_loam.name: Alluvial Loam
alluvial_loam.description: Deep, fertile soils of Indo-Gangetic and coastal plains; good water-holding and drainage

black_soil.name: Black Soil (Vertisol)
black_soil.description: Deep clayey, shrink-swell soils of Deccan plateau; rich in calcium and moisture retention

red_sandy_loam.name: Red Sandy Loam (Alfisol)
red_sandy_loam.description: Porous, well-drained soils of Southern and Eastern peninsular India; ideal for oilseeds and millets

clay_loam.name: Clay Loam
clay_loam.description: Heavy textured soil with balanced silt and clay; high fertility and water retention

sandy_soil.name: Sandy Soil
sandy_soil.description: Light coarse-textured soil; low organic matter, rapid percolation, drought-prone without constant moisture
